info.name: Faculty Exams — implemented API
info.description: Public/identity, 40 business CRUD, and scheduling/report workflows. Use interactive Authorization Code + PKCE and private access_token values. Run administrator and invigilator folders separately with the appropriate token. Workflow writes and schedule clearing must use a disposable demo database; no credentials are exported.

exec: pm.test('Both services ready', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.checks.database).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.checks.identity).to.eql('ok'); });

item.name: Unknown API does not return the SPA

exec: pm.test('Structured API error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.eql('API resource not found.'));

pm.test('Public client configuration', () => { const config = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(config.client_id).to.eql('exam-web'); pm.expect(config.issuer).to.include('/realms/'); pm.expect(config).not.to.have.property('client_secret'); });

pm.test('Verified identity and permissions', () => { const profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile.id).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(profile.role).to.be.oneOf(['member', 'administrator']); pm.expect(profile.permissions).to.be.an('array'); });

exec: pm.test('Bearer challenge instead of role login', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.include('Bearer'));

item.name: Workflow operations (administrator)
item.description: Run against a disposable demo database with a verified administrator token. Set decision_request_id to a pending request that does not conflict with existing duties. The ordered workflow reads reports/audit, decides that request, clears the schedule, plans all courses, staffs rooms, and republishes. Clear removes every exam/allocation/duty. Audit list saves the detail ID. Conflicts return 409 and reviewed requests become immutable.

request.description: Administrator with verified MFA. Counts and bounded previews are returned from one SQL snapshot.
Administrator with verified MFA. Includes personnel with zero duties; dates filter the duty count without removing zero-count rows.

request.description: Administrator with verified MFA. Eligibility for one additional duty, using the same unavailability, double-booking, daily, and consecutive-session rules as writes. request.description: Administrator with verified MFA. Includes before/after values. A batch audit uses a null entity_id and snapshots of exams, rooms, and assignments.
Administrator with verified MFA. Decides a pending request exactly once, validates duty conflicts, records the actor/time, and audits atomically. A conflict leaves the request pending.

Administrator with verified MFA. Clears exams, owned room allocations, and assignments atomically, and unpublishes. Master data, requests, and audit history remain. The client must present a clear destructive-action confirmation.

Administrator with verified MFA. Preserves existing exams. Tries unscheduled course IDs ascending, then date/start-time/session-ID ascending. Reuses room selection and scheduling rules. Entire batch rolls back if a target cannot be placed; the deterministic heuristic does not claim global infeasibility. A no-op preserves publication.

exec: pm.test('Batch result matches committed IDs', () => { const value = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.count).to.eql(value.ids.length); });

request.description: Administrator with verified MFA. Processes allocation IDs ascending, preferring eligible department staff, then lowest total duty count, then personnel ID. Existing duties remain. Entire batch, audit, and publication invalidation commit together; failure leaves no partial staffing.

exec: pm.test('Batch result matches committed IDs', () => { const value = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.count).to.eql(value.ids.length); });

request.description: Administrator with verified MFA. Publishing validates all current schedule rules and requires an invigilator for every allocation. Successful schedule changes unpublish automatically; rejected writes leave publication unchanged.

item.name: Response representations
item.description: Public fixture requests. XML/text/Atom encode the same authorized schedule data; see docs/representations.md.

item.name: Downloads (administrator)
item.description: Use a verified administrator token. Send and Download to save files. Export accepts schedule filters without page/page_size; members may call export for published data. Backup is sensitive application data; keep private. Install PostgreSQL 18 client on the API host first.
